scope: independent read-only feasibility audit; no ledger changes or task closure
dependency_semantics: depends_on 为硬集成依赖；conditional_dependencies 仅在 when 对应认证范围启用。未启用的条件任务仍标 todo/blocked/deferred，不算 done。optional-judge 不阻塞确定性或语义效果认证。

optimistic_dependency_upper_bound.method: Start with exactly the 153 done tasks. Remove the three currently unauthorized paid/live tasks and the currently uncertified P8-004 holdout gate. Repeatedly admit every remaining task whose entire depends_on list is already admitted. Ignore all actual remaining code, corpus, execution, reviewer and runtime work to obtain an upper bound, not an achievable completion promise.
optimistic_dependency_upper_bound.enabled_certification_scope: engineering/fake/local; P7-018 conditional dependencies remain disabled for P7-019/P7-020 as explicitly written in the task ledger.
optimistic_dependency_upper_bound.interpretation: Even granting all unverified public-input work and the seven planned engineering tasks, only nine original tasks precede the clean-holdout cut.

existing_user_decision_record.D3: Public fixed-repository corpus direction already authorized; no repeated permission question for this direction. Actual input locks, coverage and review remain work.
existing_user_decision_record.D1_D2: Both paid/provider calls and source-code egress are not authorized in the existing all-local decision. A broad instruction to continue TODO work is not an explicit reversal.

quantity_contract_nuance.original_table_heading: 规划覆盖（目标，不是已完成数量）
quantity_contract_nuance.inference: The original planning document alone does not establish an exact >=600 universal hard threshold. P8-002 still explicitly requires planned language/repository coverage and reviewed gold.

compat_state.cc_switch: not_run; full locked source/query/import input bundle still needed
compat_state.flask: not_run; full locked source/query/import input bundle still needed
compat_state.existing_control: Express public DEV rg baseline/control, 774 actual queries; neither requested suite nor product quality certification.

holdout_boundary_nuance: The original 04/06/09 documents require uncontaminated, frozen heldout evidence and independent gold review, not a named external institution. The concrete access-boundary/read-history blocker is recorded in the existing custody decision/protocol. A shared directory, chmod, new file name, another tuning subagent or secrecy instruction supplies no principal-isolation evidence. No new isolated cloud session was created or probed in this audit.

public_engineering_work_still_required: Complete P8-002 coverage and actual independent source/gold review using the already authorized public direction.
Obtain and lock the actual cc-switch/Flask source/query/import inputs, then execute P8-003 with the fixed product and scorer.
minimum_additional_resource_for_a_zero_m.independent_boundary: An already authorized non-tuning custodian/evaluator and a verifiably restricted environment/account, with actual principals/audience, tuner read/export exclusion, administration and first-visibility/read-history evidence. Existing authorized resources are sufficient if they establish those facts; the original contract does not require a new institution.
minimum_additional_resource_for_a_zero_m.fresh_evidence: Fresh uncontaminated heldout families with independently reviewed fixed-source gold, semantic-family separation and a preregistered split. An independent non-tuning reviewer must verify the boundary/history. The exact frozen candidate/config/scorer then receives its planned heldout run; only allowed opaque counts/hashes/results return to tuning work.
cannot_be_substituted_by: Marking an unexecuted conditional task done
Counting a prepared profile, a decision to defer, or an aggregate task before its hard dependencies
Lowering original acceptance or silently revising a frozen protocol
minimum_additional_resource_for_a_zero_m.approval_timing: Root should finish the presently authorized concrete engineering validation first; this audit is a resource diagnosis, not a user approval request.

independent_cross_review.scope: 04/06/09 original clauses, quantity nuance and alternate dependency paths
